'''???''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that depicts [[ConcernedApe]]'s profile picture. It can be obtained by interacting with a monkey in the [[Forge|Volcano Caldera]] after achieving 100% [[Perfection]]. This hat can be obtained only once per save file, or once per player in [[Multiplayer]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
